# Agatha Sowerby

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c9 P31](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0031)</sub>
- **Status:** Widow  <sub>[v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 c26 P3](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0003)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker and community volunteer  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Mrs. Agatha Sowerby is a stout woman whose gait is a waddle. She sits for hours knitting cotton warp quilts by her kitchen window.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c9 P31](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0031)_

## Personality

Agatha is an outspoken, proficient homemaker who prides herself on expressing her mind freely without fear or partiality. Intrusive and vigilant, she keeps a close watch on her neighbors' affairs and actively directs local community activities. Despite her sharp tongue and meddlesome tendencies, she is a pious, kind-hearted Christian who serves as a devoted caregiver when illness strikes.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P24](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0024), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c10 P1](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0001), [v1 c31 P7](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0007), [v2 c9 P3](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0003), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000)_

## History

Mrs. Agatha Sowerby spent many years in Brierley leading the Sewing Circle, helping direct the Sunday school, and supporting the Church Aid Society and Foreign Missions Auxiliary. Her home situated at Sowerby's Hollow allowed her to observe everyone entering or leaving the community. When Obed Abernethy and Thirza Abernethy adopted Nell, Agatha was initially skeptical and disapproving. Soon after Nell's arrival, Agatha visited Grey Shutters and made frank remarks about Nell's red hair and freckles, sparking an outburst from the girl for which Nell later apologized. Over the years, Agatha continued her active participation in church and village matters, frequently offering unsought advice and managing community efforts. After her husband Thomas passed away following a long illness, Agatha faced financial difficulties due to a farm mortgage and high medical expenses. To avoid leaving Brierley, she accepted Thirza's offer to move into Grey Shutters, establishing her living quarters in the former spare room. She provided her handcrafted quilts to Nell and her roommates when they went to college.

- Lived in Sowerby's Hollow near the main thoroughfare of Brierley  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>
